  onboard-kit                                                                                                          Begin my onboarding


  Begin my onboarding

  > Invitation file   e.g. ~/Downloads/obk-invitation-your-name.zip

  Type the path of the invitation file you were given. Its name starts with obk-invitation and ends
  with .zip.
  Your onboarding records are kept in /work, the folder you started this tool in.

  After enter, the tool asks you to confirm who you are, then shows your onboarding in this terminal.
  You type each reply.
